description: Look up a hot or established token by contract address or symbol/name. Returns the contract address DexSheet tracks, a dated automated rug check (verdict pass/caution/danger/unknown, every check with status, detail and source), other tokens using its name or symbol (copycats or bridged versions), a timestamped market snapshot (not live), pools, the DexSheet page URL and, unless the verdict is danger, where to buy. When several listed tokens share a symbol, the highest-ranked is returned and the rest are listed in other_matches.

address.description: Contract address. Solana base58 (case-sensitive) or EVM 0x… (any case).

chain.description: Optional chain: solana, ethereum, base, bsc, arbitrum.

symbol.description: Ticker or name, e.g. "FARTCOIN" or "$WIF". Used when no address is given.

name: check_token
title: Check a token: real address, rug check, lookalikes, where to buy
